title.orig: An Act Creating Two Additional Branches of the Regional Trial Court in the City of Balanga and Three Additional Branches of the Regional Trial Court in the Municipalities of Mariveles and Dinalupihan, Province of Bataan, Amending for the Purpose Section 14 Paragraph (C) of Batas Pambansa Bilang 129, Otherwise Known as "The Judiciary Reorganization Act of 1980", as Amended by Republic Act No. 7154 and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9680_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section 14, paragraph (c) of Batas Pambansa Blg. 129. otherwise known as "The Judiciary Reorganization Act of 1980", as amended by Republic Act No. 7154, is hereby further amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 14. Regional Trial Courts. - x x x
(c) Ninety-four Regional Trial Judges shall be commissioned for the Third Judicial Region. There shall be:
Ten branches with seats thereat for the Province of Bataan, with seats at Balanga, Mariveles and Dinalupihan; x x x."

The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, in coordination with the Secretary of the Department of Justice, shall immediately include in the Court's program the operationalization of five (5) additional Regional Trial Court branches in the City of Balanga and the municipalities of Mariveles and Dinalupihan, Province of Bataan, the funding of which shall be included in the annual general Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
